title: Hula 7000 Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Lemon Lime Prefilled pod combines two classic citrus fruits for a bright, tangy vape. Sweet, sunlit Lemon meets the sharper bite of Lime to create a clean, soda-inspired profile that tastes both crisp and refreshing from the first draw. These Hula Prefilled Replacement Pods are built for the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, designed to make flavour swapping as quick and tidy as possible. Each pod and refill set holds 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, with a 2ml pod that is automatically refilled from its built-in 10ml reservoir, removing the need for bottles or coil changes. Delivering up to 7000 puffs (approx.), these pods use dual mesh coil technology to keep flavour sharp and vapour production steady. Insert into your Hula kit and enjoy reliable performance paired with punchy citrus flavour. Available in 20 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
